_note: Reference for setting up each server (webhook) tool by hand in the ElevenLabs UI. This is NOT an ElevenLabs import file and the keys below are not ElevenLabs schema fields. URL = N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE + path. Store TOOL_SECRET as an ElevenLabs secret and send it in the X-Tool-Secret header. caller_phone must always come from the {{caller_phone}} dynamic variable, never from the model.

tools.name: register_user
tools.description: Register a new caller. Call this once, after a new caller tells you their first name.

body_parameters.name: caller_phone
body_parameters.value: from dynamic variable {{caller_phone}}, never from the model

body_parameters.name: name
body_parameters.description: The caller's first name, as they said it.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email from the caller's Gmail to one of their saved contacts. Only call this after reading the exact subject and message back to the caller and hearing a clear yes.

body_parameters.name: caller_phone
body_parameters.value: from dynamic variable {{caller_phone}}, never from the model

body_parameters.name: contact_name
body_parameters.description: The contact's name as the caller said it, e.g. Sarah Khan or Mum.

body_parameters.name: body
body_parameters.description: The exact message the caller approved.

tools.name: send_text
tools.description: Send a text message to one of the caller's contacts, or to a phone number. The text comes from the Brick number and starts with the caller's name. Only call this after reading the exact message back and hearing a clear yes.

body_parameters.name: caller_phone
body_parameters.value: from dynamic variable {{caller_phone}}, never from the model

body_parameters.name: contact_name
body_parameters.description: The contact's name as the caller said it, or a phone number.

body_parameters.name: message
body_parameters.description: The exact message the caller approved, without their name in front.

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder. At the given time the caller gets a text. Confirm the time out loud before calling. Reminders can be at most 7 days ahead.

body_parameters.name: caller_phone
body_parameters.value: from dynamic variable {{caller_phone}}, never from the model

body_parameters.name: text
body_parameters.description: What to remind them about, e.g. take your tablets.

body_parameters.name: remind_at
body_parameters.description: When, in ISO 8601 with an offset, worked out from {{now}}, e.g. 2026-11-07T20:00:00+00:00.

tools.name: read_emails
tools.description: Read out the caller's unread emails: sender, subject and a one-line summary each.

body_parameters.name: caller_phone
body_parameters.value: from dynamic variable {{caller_phone}}, never from the model
